q_45367.question_text: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q2 FY2027 earnings release? (Revenue)
q_45367.reasoning:
# NVIDIA Q2 FY2027 Forward Guidance Forecast

## (a) Time Left Until Resolution

Today is 2026-08-17. NVIDIA's Q2 FY2027 earnings release would typically occur around late August or early September 2026, meaning resolution is approximately **2-3 weeks away**.

## (b) Most Likely Outcome and Why

According to the CURRENT RESEARCH provided, **NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for Q2 FY2027**. On May 20, 2026, the company announced it expects revenue to be **$91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%**.

This means the official guidance range is:
- **$89.18 billion** (91.0 - 2%)
- **$92.82 billion** (91.0 + 2%)

The most likely outcome is that the company's actual forward guidance will be **$91.0 billion ± 2%**, as this has already been publicly announced and disclosed in SEC filings.

## (c) What Would Push the Value Lower?

- **Downward guidance revision** due to macro headwinds, China restrictions intensifying, or weaker-than-expected demand
- A surprising announcement of additional export restrictions or geopolitical complications
- Material loss of a major customer or unexpected market share loss
- However, given that guidance has been publicly announced, a material revision would be unusual absent major intervening events

## (d) What Would Push the Value Higher?

- **Upward guidance revision** if demand exceeds expectations, particularly from AI/data center segments
- Unexpected acceleration in enterprise or hyperscaler spending
- Favorable changes to China export policy or other geopolitical factors
- A significant acquisition or expansion announcement
- Again, revisions are rare once guidance is formally announced

## (e) Base Rate or Historical Reference Values

The research explicitly states NVIDIA's forward guidance for Q2 FY2027 is **$91.0 billion ± 2%**. This is not a forecast—it is the company's publicly announced guidance as of May 20, 2026.

The guidance range provided in the question (99.5 to 115.5 billion) encompasses the announced $91.0 billion guidance. However, given that formal guidance has been provided, the actual outcome should cluster tightly around $91.0 billion unless NVIDIA revises its guidance significantly before the earnings call—which would be highly unusual less than 3 weeks after the guidance was announced.

q_45367.research_text:
NVIDIA has already provided forward guidance for its second quarter of fiscal year 2027. On May 20, 2026, the company announced that it expects revenue to be $91.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. This outlook does not assume any Data Center compute revenue from China [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/). This figure is significantly higher than the average quarterly revenue estimate of $86.84 billion from LSEG [cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/05/20/nvidia-nvda-earnings-report-q1-2027.html).

For the same quarter, NVIDIA also projects GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins to be 74.9% and 75.0% respectively, plus or minus 50 basis points. GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $8.5 billion, and non-GAAP operating expenses around $8.3 billion [investor.nvidia.com](https://investor.nvidia.com/news/press-release-details/2026/NVIDIA-Announces-Financial-Results-for-First-Quarter-Fiscal-2027/), [sec.gov](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1045810/000104581026000051/q1fy27pr.htm), [nvidianews.nvidia.com](https://nvidianews.nvidia.com/news/nvidia-announces-financial-results-for-first-quarter-fiscal-2027/).
